description: React component for UI notifications using react-toastify, including methods for different notification types and layout options.

classes.name: Notifications
classes.description: React component managing notification display and layout options.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial success toast upon component mount.

methods.name: addInfoNotification
methods.description: Displays an informational notification with a cancel button.

methods.name: launchNotification
methods.description: Updates a notification to indicate success.

methods.name: addErrorNotification
methods.description: Displays an error notification with a retry button.

methods.name: retryNotification
methods.description: Updates a notification to indicate success after retry.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the notifications UI with layout and control buttons.
